offering_description.value: Rents construction, industrial and specialty equipment, and sells used equipment and parts, to contractors, industrial companies and homeowners through a branch network across North America. It delivers equipment to job sites and provides setup, maintenance and operator training.

primary_products.value: general construction equipment; aerial work platforms; earthmoving equipment; industrial equipment; power and HVAC equipment

primary_services.value: equipment delivery and pickup; equipment maintenance; operator training; equipment setup

customer_segment.value: B2B: construction contractors, industrial companies, event and facility managers; B2C: homeowners and do-it-yourself users; B2G: public agencies and their contractors

end_markets.value: construction; industrial manufacturing; energy; infrastructure; events and entertainment

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: equipment rental fees paid by customers for set rental periods; product sales: sales of used equipment and parts; service fees: delivery, setup, repair and operator training charges
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs a rental fleet, renting equipment to contractors and industrial customers; service provider: delivers, maintains and sets up equipment at customer sites

geography_served.value: North America: US states and Canadian provinces, served through branch locations

specialization.value: related lines: general equipment rental, specialty equipment rental and related sales and services

distribution_channels.value: own locations: branch network across North America; direct sales: national account sales teams serving large customers; online: online reservations and equipment sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: vehicle and transport safety, equipment safety and environmental rules, such as DOT and OSHA requirements
